name: Green bell pepper (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Green bell pepper (Capsicum annuum) [Vegetables] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, Edible Medicinal And Non-Medicinal Plants: Volume 6, Fruits. By T. K. Lim, MANUAL, Nutrition and You, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 170427 (Peppers, sweet, green, raw)
Zhang et al. 2022, Frontiers in Nutrition 9:1027605, PMC9871545 (organic acids & sugars of green pepper, Capsicum annuum)
provenance.curation_notes: Green (unripe) sweet bell pepper is a ~94% water, low-sugar matrix. Dominant fermentable carbon = free glucose ~= fructose (~1.1-1.2 g/100g each; sucrose minor), plus a substantial organic-acid pool led by citric acid (~0.37 g/100g) with malic, fumaric and alpha-ketoglutarate; these organic acids were entirely missing from the FooDB profile and are the key correction. Very rich in vitamin C (~80 mg/100g). Capsaicinoids are near-zero in the non-pungent sweet bell pepper but retained as uncovered
curation_added: citric acid (dominant organic acid, was absent)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
